programmes.d: Explorers in Mexico uncover the ruins of an ancient snake-worshiping civilization. Celebration turns to horror when they awaken an ever-growing anaconda, starved of human sacrifices for centuries. Now, the team must band together to survive.

A change in plans has the team rerouted to a Colorado viral lab located in an abandoned but still operational nuclear missile silo where our heroes search for Doctor Merch, the developer of the experimental vaccine given to Murphy in the pilot.

What is supposed to be a marriage boot camp on a remote island turns into the ultimate test for survival when a 6-headed shark starts attacking the beach. Trapped with minimal weapons, they discover that no one is safe in the water or on land.
When a tour guide breaks into America's Most Haunted House, a bit of amateur ghost hunting with friends turns into more horror than they could have ever imagined.

On the day of Frankenstein's Monster and the Bride of Frankenstein's Monster's wedding, villagers riot and kill Frankenstein. The Bride escapes, vows revenge, and eventually resurrects Frankenstein's Monster, - leading a trail of blood in her wake.

programmes.t: King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table
programmes.d: Following an epic battle, Merlin banishes Morgana, and her son, Mordred, to the ends of the universe. Vowing revenge, Morgana and her son return to Earth 1,500 years later, and they are hell-bent on destroying every descendant of King Arthur.
An eavesdropper hears a serial killer's phone conversation, then must find the madman before he claims another victim.
When a freak hurricane swamps Los Angeles, thousands of sharks terrorize the waterlogged populace, and nature's deadliest killer rules sea, land, and air.
Born over 400 years ago, Sawney Bean and his inbred clan slaughtered and devoured thousands. To this day, the brutal cannibals lurk in seaside caves, preying on anyone who crosses their path.
While searching for an unidentified submersible, a military vessel crosses paths with a giant shark & are forced to use only what they have on board to defend themselves from the monstrous beast.
Sandy's past indiscretion with her fiancé's best friend Roman comes back to haunt her when he becomes their best man. Delusional and deranged, Roman will stop at nothing to make Sandy his own bride.
After crash-landing back to Earth, an ape grows to an enormous size and dukes it out with a gigantic Gila monster.
While the Civil War rages on, President Abraham Lincoln must undertake an even more daunting task: Destroying the Confederate Undead.

A global summit fails to stop a massive asteroid headed straight for Earth. With the outlook now bleak, a young tech genius assembles her own team of specialists, using aeronautics, in a last-ditch effort to stop the asteroid before it's too late.
